source_manifest.transformations: Exact source selections; no tiling, artificial perturbations or regridding. Reference indexed by exact valid time and shared across members.
source_manifest.provider_processing: dynamical.org converts native GRIB to Celsius Zarr and rounds floating-point bits; not bitwise native GRIB.
source_manifest.license: CC BY 4.0 for provider archives; ECMWF Terms of Use also apply to ECMWF-derived data.
source_manifest.attribution: ECMWF IFS ENS forecast and NOAA NWS NCEP GFS data processed by dynamical.org from their open-data archives.
source_manifest.interpretation: Separate per-initialization/lead/member spatial metrics; descriptive pooled errors are not ensemble-mean forecast skill. Reference is GFS analysis, not independent truth. Overlapping valid times and related members are not independent samples.

identity.transform: (Celsius - 20.0) / 20.0 in FP64, then FP32; fixed benchmark scaling, not trained-model normalization

timing: Direct wall read/select/decode/coordinate validation only; reopen includes open/close, once readers share a handle. FP32 packing, input/identity/coordinate checks, hashes, probes and CSV/JSON writing are outside primary timing. Genuine A/B per repeat, shuffled case/reader ordering, no prepared-input cache.
probe: Separate instrumented fresh-handle LocalStore get observations with all returned key/byte records. Counts forecast compressed bytes returned by Store API, not actual disk/network traffic or decode invocation counts. Not used as primary timings. Logical selected forecast array/backing bytes exclude temporary decoder/indexer arrays and are not peak process RAM.
limits: No cold-cache claim; setup/probes/validation warm OS/library state. Source chunks/codec are unchanged. No model execution, remote download, training or forecast-quality evaluation in reader-only timings.
